name: @coldmail-send-managed/worker
description: Phase-0 SKELETON SendManaged Worker: pure mTLS relay client. NO DB, NO KMS, memory-only creds. Registers + heartbeats. No SMTP send (Phase 5+).

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/workerlink.js && node --check src/creds.js && node --check src/stream.js && node --check src/smtp.js && node --check src/variation.js && node --check src/variation-seed.js && node --check src/variation-content.js && node --check src/variation-headers.js && node --check src/mime-headers.js && node --check src/mime-codec.js && node --check src/assemble.js

comment_dependencies: INTENTIONALLY EMPTY. The worker ships NO database driver and NO KMS SDK — the no-DB/no-KMS boundary (CLAUDE.md Rule 6) is structural. mTLS uses Node's built-in https/tls. Adding 'pg', a KMS SDK, or any DB client here is a review-blocking defect.
